name: Federation Logistics, LLC
what_they_do: Third-party logistics and warehousing company: container drayage from the NJ/NY ports, bonded and liquor-licensed warehousing, kitting, transportation and distribution from New Jersey and California.
customers: Importers, beverage/alcohol brands needing bonded storage, consumer-goods shippers

size_signals.signal: 500,000 sq ft of combined warehouse and rack space; 250,000 sq ft on the East Coast
Fleet of over 16 drivers; 30 miles from the ports
Site claims 'over 45 years of experience' in one paragraph and '40 Years' in another - inconsistent

website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Quote form with roughly 70 fields; no scheduler
website_review.trust_signals: US Customs bonded, liquor licence, SQF, UIIA, safety claims, 40-year heritage, photos and a video
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Main nav 'About us', 'Services' and 'Contact' all link to '#'; a template placeholder email (help@company.com) is live in the markup; no meta description; animated stat counters show '0' until JS runs
website_review.search_basics: Page title is just 'Federation Logistics, LLC' with no description or town; H1 is 'Hundreds of customers trust our company'; no JSON-LD; robots.txt returns 404 (so nothing is blocked); services live on the home page rather than their own URLs
top_issues: 70-field quote form is a barrier most prospects will abandon
At 390px the hero area renders blank and the 'Get a free quote' tab overflows the screen edge
No structured data, no meta description, no per-service pages

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: GBP is unclaimed ('Claim this business') though it carries category, hours and site link; robots.txt 404 so nothing is blocked. Answerable: services, address and hours are real text, but no schema, no meta description and no service-level pages. Bookable: a large quote form posts back to quote.php (labels present) but there is no scheduler or acknowledgement path an agent can use.

operations_signals.signal: Quote intake is a ~70-input form covering monthly volume by month, pallet specs and EDI setup - staff must read and re-key it
Broken nav and a placeholder email indicate the site is maintained reactively, not by a marketing function
Bonded/liquor-licensed warehouse work implies customs and ABC paperwork that appears to be handled by hand (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the 70-field quote form with a short intake plus an AI-assisted qualification step that asks for volume/pallet detail progressively
top_opportunities.evidence: quote.php collects ~70 inputs including 12 monthly volume fields before a human speaks to the prospect

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the broken site: working nav and service pages, meta description naming warehousing/drayage in North Brunswick, LocalBusiness schema, claim the GBP
top_opportunities.evidence: About/Services/Contact links are '#'; no meta description; GBP shows 'Claim this business'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated quote follow-up and document collection for bonded/customs paperwork
top_opportunities.evidence: Bonded and liquor-licensed services plus a mailto contact; no portal or upload flow found

scores.reasons: Gap 5: broken nav, no meta description, no schema, hostile quote form. Pay 3: established 3PL with 500k sq ft and port drayage revenue but a small, family-run feel. Ease 4: static PHP site, fixes are direct. Evidence 5: home, quote form and robots inspected, GBP seen.
